mapper.select: select concat('POST:', ranked.place_id) point_key, 'POST' source_type, null category, ranked.post_id target_id, ranked.place_id, ranked.place_name title, ranked.post_title summary, ranked.cover_url, ranked.address, ranked.latitude, ranked.longitude, ranked.content_count, 0 related_count from ( select post.post_id, post.place_id, place.place_name, post.title post_title, place.address, place.latitude, place.longitude, (select resource.resource_url from shop_zhenke_post_resource resource where resource.post_id=post.post_id and resource.resource_type='IMAGE' order by resource.resource_sort,resource.resource_id limit 1) cover_url, row_number() over(partition by post.place_id order by post.published_at desc,post.post_id desc) point_rank, count(*) over(partition by post.place_id) content_count from shop_zhenke_post post join shop_place place on place.place_id=post.place_id and place.status='0' join shop_user author on author.user_id=post.shop_user_id and author.del_flag='0' where post.del_flag='0' and post.status='PUBLISHED' and (trim(place.city)=#{city} or trim(place.city)=#{cityKeyword}) ) ranked where ranked.point_rank=1 order by ranked.post_id desc

select concat('ENJOY:', ranked.category, ':', ranked.place_id) point_key, 'ENJOY' source_type, ranked.category, ranked.enjoy_id target_id, ranked.place_id, ranked.title, ranked.place_name summary, ranked.cover_url, ranked.address, ranked.latitude, ranked.longitude, ranked.content_count, 0 related_count from ( select enjoy.enjoy_id, enjoy.category, enjoy.place_id, enjoy.title, enjoy.cover_url, place.place_name, place.address, place.latitude, place.longitude, row_number() over( partition by enjoy.category,enjoy.place_id order by enjoy.display_sort,enjoy.published_at desc,enjoy.enjoy_id desc ) point_rank, count(*) over(partition by enjoy.category,enjoy.place_id) content_count from shop_zhenke_enjoy enjoy join shop_place place on place.place_id=enjoy.place_id and place.status='0' where enjoy.del_flag='0' and enjoy.status='0' and (trim(place.city)=#{city} or trim(place.city)=#{cityKeyword}) ) ranked where ranked.point_rank=1 order by field(ranked.category,'SCENIC','RESTAURANT','HOTEL','MALL'),ranked.enjoy_id desc

select concat('MERCHANT:', merchant.merchant_id) point_key, 'MERCHANT' source_type, null category, merchant.merchant_id target_id, null place_id, coalesce(nullif(trim(merchant.shop_name),''),merchant.company_name) title, merchant.product_intro summary, (select product.cover_url from shop_product product where product.merchant_id=merchant.merchant_id and product.status='ON_SALE' and product.del_flag='0' order by product.sales_count desc,product.product_id desc limit 1) cover_url, merchant.company_address address, merchant.latitude, merchant.longitude, (select count(*) from shop_product product where product.merchant_id=merchant.merchant_id and product.status='ON_SALE' and product.del_flag='0') content_count, (select count(*) from shop_verification_report report join shop_product product on product.product_id=report.product_id where product.merchant_id=merchant.merchant_id and report.status='PUBLISHED') related_count from shop_merchant merchant where merchant.audit_status='APPROVED' and merchant.status='0' and merchant.del_flag='0' and (merchant.company_address like concat('%',#{city},'%') or merchant.company_address like concat('%',#{cityKeyword},'%')) and merchant.latitude is not null and merchant.longitude is not null order by merchant.update_time desc,merchant.merchant_id desc
